objective: Candidate proposal, part of storytold/lightcraft#3479: add an opt-in, persisted 24-hour capture-time display preference independent of UI language, initially configurable in ui.json. Preserve existing defaults. This is a local specification only, not accepted upstream scope or execution authorization.

behavior_criteria.description: Proposed configuration (agent design choice, pending review): ui.json settings.timeFormat accepts language (default) and 24h. Missing preference retains the current language-dependent output; existing saved language and unrelated preferences survive loading and round trips. Unknown future values fall back to language without discarding unrelated settings.

With English UI and timeFormat=24h, a valid capture timestamp 2022-03-30T22:11:11 is shown in the real Info panel as March 30, 2022 at 22:11:11, with no AM/PM. Test midnight 00:00:00, noon 12:00:00 and 23:59:59 as well. English labels and date wording remain English.

With timeFormat=language the current formatter output is unchanged, including English 12-hour AM/PM and existing non-English output. With explicit 24h, non-English date wording stays in the chosen language and valid full clock values remain 24-hour.

The persisted preference reaches actual Info-panel rendering after loading ui.json and app logic/UI passes. A headless regression must exercise UiState deserialization, the app activation path and the visible Captured value, rather than testing an unused helper. Re-loading language restores the old presentation.

Date-only, partial dates and malformed or non-ASCII input retain their existing display behavior; missing seconds follow existing behavior. No panic, timezone conversion, metadata rewrite or catalog mutation. Formatting a photo must leave its capture timestamp unchanged.

Document the configuration, default and limits in docs/localization.md; record a partial #3479 entry in localization gap 21 and LR-BEHAV-LOCALIZE, plus an opt-in release note. Do not claim OS regional settings, number separators, all timestamp surfaces or the full issue are implemented. Record before/after LightCraft screenshots of the real Info panel and inspect the output.
